name: Akul
description: Akul is a dragon and the feared leader of the Hellspurs, who hunts for the last piece of a key to the vault beneath Tarnation.

timeline.summary: Akul splits the carriage, takes the sack and declares the last key his, but finds only coal and flies into a rage.
timeline.quote: "Finally. The last key is mine."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Archie dies in the burning sand while the real key gets farther away from Akul.
timeline.quote: For all he cared about punctuality, he never expected to be so early to his own death.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie Flash follows the smoke on Fortune, recognises Akul's work in the burned carriage and finds an untouched lockbox of cash.
timeline.quote: A lockbox sat inside, untouched.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie deduces that the Hellspurs left the money because they were after something bigger.
timeline.quote: But they left the money behind—which meant they were after something else.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko offers Annie revenge by recruiting her for a heist against Akul, and she refuses.
timeline.quote: I've been putting a team together to steal something important from an outlaw you may know as Akul.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie agrees to join the crew, but only as far as stopping Akul.
timeline.quote: "I'm in—but only as far as stopping Akul."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Ashiok appears and explains they hired the crew to break into the vault, which Akul built the town of Tarnation around.
timeline.quote: Akul and the Hellspurs built an entire town around the vault hoping to control it.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko explains that Bertram Graywater holds the key and that the courier Akul chased was a decoy.
timeline.quote: he had Akul halfway across the desert chasing a decoy courier

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul interrogates a mine overseer, learning of a shapeshifting fae thief, and sends the Hellspurs after him.
timeline.quote: It was some shapeshifting fae from another plane.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul kills the overseer with his tail stinger.
timeline.quote: Akul whipped the barbed, venomous stinger on the end of his tail into the man's gut

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reports that the artifact is one of six keys, Akul holds the other five in a medallion, and a map to Tarnation is buried in Thief's Folly.
timeline.quote: Akul has the other five. He wears them in a medallion around his neck

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie tells Kellan how Akul hunted the Freestriders and injured her nephew, and why she cannot let him get the vault's power.
timeline.quote: A while back, I was with the Freestriders.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul mocks Annie about her nephew and says he will watch them suffer.
timeline.quote: How is that nephew of yours?

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul confronts the chained crew, takes the sixth key from Oko and assembles the full key in his medallion.
timeline.quote: Akul slotted the sixth key into the medallion

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan challenges Akul to a duel; Oko and the others goad Akul's pride until he agrees to a duel at midnight.
timeline.quote: The duel begins at midnight.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul declares the duel a fight to the death.
timeline.quote: "This is a fight to the death!"

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan dodges Akul's attacks, but his lasso and spear fail against the dragon's scales.
timeline.quote: Akul's scales were too thick to pierce.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Cornered by Akul's thunder, Kellan taps an untouched fae power and lulls the dragon into a trance.
timeline.quote: The dragon lost focus, thunder spinning from his teeth in a harmless sigh.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan tries to choke the entranced Akul, but his guilt breaks the spell and Akul pins him.
timeline.quote: Kellan was wedged beneath him, unable to move.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The Sterling Company army led by Ral Zarek attacks Tarnation, interrupting the duel.
timeline.quote: The Sterling Company had found Tarnation—and they had brought an army.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul and the Hellspurs arrive, and Rakdos tackles him.
timeline.quote: Rakdos smashed into his side and clobbered him to the ground.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul seizes Annie, but Kellan takes control of the dragon's mind and orders him back into the collapsing vault.
timeline.quote: "Go back inside the vault—and don't come out."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Rocks seal Akul inside, and the vault shoots into the clouds and vanishes.
timeline.quote: the vault shot toward the clouds and vanished from sight.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul disposes of a would-be usurper among the Hellspurs, leaving the sheriff to piece things together.
timeline.quote: Akul Disposes of Would-Be Usurper

citation.text: Terminal Agony (Breaking News, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As the vault collapses, Kellan makes sure Akul cannot follow them out.
timeline.quote: As the vault collapsed around them, Kellan made sure Akul couldn't follow them out.

citation.text: Getaway Glamer (Outlaws of Thunder Junction, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Akul regards his Hellspur followers as ammunition to be expended.
timeline.quote: Akul saw his Hellspur followers as little more than ammunition to be expended.

citation.text: Pitiless Carnage (Outlaws of Thunder Junction, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Akul's gang kills courier Archie Dixon and two guards seeking the final key piece, which is not there.
timeline.quote: killing a courier named Archie Dixon and two Sterling Company guards

citation.text: "Akul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko's gang is captured at Tarnation and Akul takes the final key piece, completing the key.
timeline.quote: completing the true key to Maag Taranau

citation.text: "Akul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan challenges Akul to a duel.
timeline.quote: Akul was challenged to a duel by Kellan

citation.text: "Akul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sterling mercenaries attack Tarnation and Oko steals the key.
timeline.quote: it was stolen by Oko

citation.text: "Akul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akul is defeated by Rakdos at the vault; Oko opens it for Jace, who takes treasure and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: with Akul being defeated by Rakdos

citation.text: "Akul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan mind-controls Akul into the vault, which rockets into the sky with him inside.
timeline.quote: ordering him to walk into the vault and never leave.

citation.text: "Akul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Freestriders rob Akul and the Hellspurs, Akul hunts them and nearly kills Annie's nephew Tommy with his venom.
timeline.quote: Akul attacked them regardless, almost killing Annie's nephew Tommy with his venom

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Annie, Oko, Kellan and Vraska are captured in Tarnation and Akul takes the final piece of the key; Kellan challenges Akul to a duel.
timeline.quote: the four were captured and brought before Akul, who took the final piece of the vault's key

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek arrives with Sterling mercenaries and strikes Akul; Tinybones frees the captives and Vraska petrifies their captors.
timeline.quote: he was struck by thunder as Ral Zarek arrived with Sterling mercenaries

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The crew enters the vault; Annie finds the security grid and Akul and the Hellspurs arrive.
timeline.quote: Annie used her enhanced eyesight to search for traps

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As the vault collapses, Kellan controls Akul's mind, sending him into the vault so he and Annie escape.
timeline.quote: Kellan used his magic to control Akul's mind, sending the dragon into the collapsing vault

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Tarnation the group is captured and Kellan challenges Akul to a duel.
timeline.quote: Kellan, searching for any way to escape death, challenged the dragon to a duel

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sterling mercenaries led by Ral, tipped off by Oko, interrupt the duel; Oko steals the vault key and Kellan is knocked out.
timeline.quote: he saw his father regarding him with indifference as he left for the vault

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan fully accepts his fae heritage and mind-controls Akul into releasing Annie and entering the vault forever.
timeline.quote: ordering him to release Annie, go into the vault, and never come out

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko recruits Annie Flash for her ability to see through illusions.
timeline.quote: attempting to recruit her for her ability to see through illusions

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akul combines Oko's key with his five; Kellan challenges Akul to a duel, and Oko uses the Sterling raid to steal the full key.
timeline.quote: Oko had Tinybones unchain him and steal the complete key, making for the vault.

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko recruits Rakdos for his heist of Maag Taranau on Thunder Junction; Rakdos knocks away Ral Zarek and defeats Akul.
timeline.quote: Oko recruited Rakdos for his heist of Maag Taranau

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska turns Akul's captors to stone as Oko's team escapes Tarnation.
timeline.quote: Tinybones reassembled and unlocked their chains, allowing Vraska to turn their remaining captors to stone

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Omenpaths open, parties race for the Vault; Akul builds Tarnation, and Graywater collects keys.
timeline.quote: Akul and the Hellspurs built Tarnation around the vault hoping to control it.

citation.text: "Maag Taranau", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akul takes the key from the gang and fits it to his medallion, revealing six pieces of one key; Oko steals it back.
timeline.quote: Oko stole this final key back during a shootout

citation.text: "Maag Taranau", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko opens the vault and Jace takes the infant and planeswalks, triggering a trap that sends the vault into space with Akul sealed inside.
timeline.quote: with Akul sealed inside

citation.text: "Maag Taranau", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akul traveled to Thunder Junction and formed the Hellspurs.
timeline.quote: The scorpion dragon Akul to traveled to Thunder Junction and formed The Hellspurs .

citation.text: "Gastal", section "Omenpath Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akul names his Thunder Junction gang the Hellspurs.
timeline.quote: named his Thunder Junction gang the Hellspurs

citation.text: "Hell", section "Things named after hell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Freestriders rob the Hellspurs, Akul tracks them down and attacks them even after they return the loot, nearly killing Tommy.
timeline.quote: Akul attacked them regardless, almost killing Annie Flash 's nephew Tommy with his venom

citation.text: "Hellspurs", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Around 4564 AR Akul's gang attacks a carriage transport, killing the courier Archie Dixon and two Sterling Company guards to get the last key piece.
timeline.quote: killing a courier named Archie Dixon and two Sterling Company guards

citation.text: "Hellspurs", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko and his gang infiltrate Tarnation, are captured, and Akul takes the final key piece; Kellan challenges Akul to a duel and Akul accepts.
timeline.quote: Akul was challenged to a duel by Kellan

citation.text: "Hellspurs", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sterling mercenaries tipped off by Oko attack Tarnation, Oko steals the key and the Hellspurs are defeated.
timeline.quote: The Hellspurs were ultimately defeated by the Sterling mercenaries.

citation.text: "Hellspurs", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the vault Oko opens it for Jace, who takes treasure and planeswalks away; Rakdos defeats Akul and Kellan mind controls him.
timeline.quote: Akul, for his part, was defeated by Rakdos in single combat

citation.text: "Hellspurs", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko steals the key back during a Sterling-Hellspur shootout.
timeline.quote: Oko stole it back during a Sterling–Hellspur shootout

citation.text: "The Vault Heist", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko lets himself be captured at Tarnation so Akul combines the pieces, then reclaims the key and abandons Kellan.
timeline.quote: intentionally allowing their capture so Akul would combine all six pieces into the complete key

citation.text: "The Vault Heist", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The vault launches into the sky with Akul trapped inside, then falls back; Jace and Vraska planeswalk away with Loot.
timeline.quote: The vault launched into the sky with Akul trapped inside before later falling back to the surface.

citation.text: "The Vault Heist", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko's gang disbands; Kellan compels Akul into the collapsing vault to save Annie, then invites Amalia to explore Thunder Junction.
timeline.quote: Kellan embraced his fae powers to save Annie from Akul

citation.text: "The Vault Heist", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tinybones helps navigate the vault's traps and escapes after Akul assaults them.
timeline.quote: Tinybones helped navigate the maze of traps within the vault of Maag Taranau

citation.text: "Tinybones", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Annie's gang robs Akul and the Hellspurs, and Akul hunts the Freestriders.
timeline.quote: After her gang robbed Akul and the Hellspurs

citation.text: "Tommy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akul stings Tommy, causing him chronic pain.
timeline.quote: This led to Tommy being stung by the scorpion dragon Akul

citation.text: "Tommy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: since the day Akul almost killed her nephew

citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

relations.quote: "Enough!" Akul snarled, spit flying through his teeth.

citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

relations.quote: We needed Akul to let his guard down, and he did.

citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

relations.quote: It wasn't just hypnosis—it was control .
